action.description: 'schedule' creates a future main-session wake-up; 'list' shows pending, delivered and cancelled wake-ups; 'cancel' aborts a pending wake-up.

delay_seconds.description: Delay before injecting the message for 'schedule'. Defaults to 60 seconds.

id.description: Wake-up id; required for 'cancel' and reported by 'list'.

message.description: Message to inject into the main chat session when the wake-up fires; required for 'schedule'.

priority.description: When true, 'schedule' injects the wake-up as a priority /now message.
